raw_definitions: Definisi : n bahaya: a life full of ~, hidup yg penuh bahaya; the ~ of fire, bahaya kebakaran; to run into ~, menemui bahaya; ~ point, /peringkat, takat/ bahaya; ~ list, senarai pesakit tenat; be a ~ to , membahayakan: he is a ~ to society, dia membahayakan masyarakat; the conflict between the two countries is a ~ to peace in South-East Asia, perselisihan antara dua negara itu membahayakan keamanan di Asia Tenggara; be in ~, dlm (keadaan) bahaya: the child’s health is in ~, kesihatan anak itu dlm bahaya; be in ~ of, menghadapi bahaya: the building is in ~ of falling down, bangunan itu menghadapi bahaya akan runtuh; he is in ~ of losing all his assets, dia menghadapi bahaya akan kehilangan semua hartanya; be out of ~, terlepas drpd bahaya: the patient is now out of ~, pesakit itu sudah terselamat drpd bahaya sekarang. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
